name: Epic

title: "epic: "
labels: "epic"

---

## Outcome and scope

State the user outcome, non-goals, compatibility and safety constraints.

## Child issues and dependencies

Link implementation-ready issues; do not duplicate their bodies or private plans.

## Exit criteria

- [ ] All required child outcomes are accepted and merged.
- [ ] Compatibility and migration requirements are verified.
- [ ] Applicable tests, isolated runtime and native UI/HACS checks are complete.
- [ ] User/contributor documentation and release notes agree with actual behavior.
- [ ] Known limitations and evidence boundaries remain explicit.

## Release boundary

Name a concrete milestone and remaining blockers. Publication and live operations
require their own scope; completing an epic does not authorize appliance commands.
